name: Major Samuelson
summary: In Stormwind Keep, Major Samuelson directs the city guard and its officers. He serves in the throne room and once mentored Lieutenant Farren Orinelle.

sections.title: A Pillar of Stormwind's Guard
sections.body:
Major Samuelson leads the Stormwind City Guard before the royal court. From the capital, he oversees officer postings and military orders across the realm. He once mentored Lieutenant Farren Orinelle, now stationed at Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

Junior commanders at distant frontier garrisons send their reports and requests for transfer to Samuelson. When they struggle, their appeals reach his desk in Stormwind.

aliases: who is the major in keep
faq.answer: Major Samuelson commands the Stormwind City Guard from Stormwind Keep's throne room. He oversees officer postings and personnel.

faq.q: Where can Major Samuelson be found?
faq.answer: Major Samuelson stands in Stormwind Keep's throne room, near the boy-king Anduin Wrynn and Highlord Bolvar Fordragon.

faq.q: What is his connection to Southshore?
faq.answer: Major Samuelson mentored Lieutenant Farren Orinelle, who is stationed at Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills. Orinelle seeks reassignment from his stressful northern post through Samuelson.

faq.q: Why do adventurers seek him out?
faq.answer: Travelers from the northern front in Hillsbrad bring Lieutenant Farren Orinelle's official reassignment request to Major Samuelson in Stormwind Keep.

angles.text: As an Alliance officer, Major Samuelson directs Stormwind's military personnel from the royal throne room, including those serving in contested lands such as Hillsbrad.
